costs.title: Costs
costs.subtitle: Every cost the business incurs — this is what makes the accountant's figures accurate
costs.recordHint: Supplier invoices, repairs, fuel, rent — anything the business pays for.
costs.voidHint: It stops counting towards VAT and Zakat. The entry is kept, never deleted.
costs.seasonsSubtitle: Every season carries its employee charges, so payroll lands in the cost base
costs.seasonHint: Seasons run about six months. Employee charges are added per season.
costs.noCharges: No employee charges yet — open it to add them.
costs.nowCounts: It now counts towards the VAT and Zakat figures.
costs.noLongerCounts: It no longer counts towards the tax figures.
costs.chargeNext: Charge its employees next — every season must carry them.
costs.noCostsHint: Record the first supplier invoice or repair.

season.title: Season
season.costsBooked: Operating costs booked to this season
season.nobodyToChargeHint: There are no operational employees in this tenant yet.
season.noCostsHint: Record one from the Costs page and tie it to this season.
season.unchargedWhy: Every season must carry its employee charges, or the cost base is understated and the VAT and Zakat come out too high. {{names}}.
season.uncharged_one: {{count}} employee is not charged to this season yet
season.uncharged_other: {{count}} employees are not charged to this season yet
season.allOnSeason: Every employee is on this season

payroll.title: Charge employees to the season
payroll.allCharged: Every employee is already on this season
payroll.nothingLeft: There is nothing left to charge. Hire someone and they will appear here.
